# Australian Fire Protection (AustFirePro)

> Professional fire safety training, emergency response certification, and workplace compliance services for Brisbane, Gold Coast, and Queensland.

Australian Fire Protection is an RTO 45740-accredited training provider specializing in nationally recognised fire safety and emergency control courses. They offer comprehensive training programs ranging from general occupancy awareness to advanced Fire Safety Adviser certifications, serving businesses across Brisbane and Gold Coast with on-site and facility-based delivery.

## Key Topics

- Fire Safety Training
- Emergency Control Organisation (ECO)
- Fire Warden Training
- Workplace Safety Compliance
- Evacuation Procedures
- Fire Extinguisher Training
- Nationally Recognised Certification
- Professional Fire Safety Adviser
- Emergency Response
- Lithium Battery Fire Safety
- Code Black Emergency Response
- Chief Fire Warden
- RTO 45740
- Brisbane & Gold Coast
- Queensland Regulations

## Nationally Recognised Training Courses

- [Course Category: Nationally Recognised Training - Australian Fire Protection Training Courses](https://courses.austfirepro.com.au/course_categories/nationally-recognised-training): Nationally recognised fire safety and emergency control courses
- [PUAFER005 Operate as an Emergency Control Organisation](https://austfirepro.com.au/puafer005): PUAFER005 nationally recognised ECO operator training course
- [PUAFER006 Lead an Emergency Control Organisation | Aus Fire Protection](https://austfirepro.com.au/puafer006): PUAFER006 nationally recognised ECO leadership training course
- [Fire Safety Adviser Training Course | QLD Regulations](https://austfirepro.com.au/fire-safety-adviser-course): Fire Safety Adviser certification compliant with QLD regulations
- [Fire Safety Adviser Training Course | QLD Regulations](https://austfirepro.com.au/fire-safety-adviser-1-day-refresher-course): Fire Safety Adviser 1-day refresher course for QLD compliance
- [Fire Safety Officer (NSW Healthcare) Training Gold Coast](https://austfirepro.com.au/fire-safety-officer): Fire Safety Officer training for NSW Healthcare facilities

## Fire Safety & Emergency Response Training

- [Fire Safety Awareness Gold Coast | Australian Fire Protection](https://austfirepro.com.au/training-services): Professional fire safety training services in Gold Coast with fast turnaround
- [Comprehensive Fire Extinguisher Training | AustFirePro](https://austfirepro.com.au/fire-extinguisher-training): Fire extinguisher handling and usage training across Brisbane, Gold Coast
- [Fire Warden Training Online | Australian Fire Protection](https://austfirepro.com.au/fire-warden-training): Fire Warden training compliant with Australian Standards in QLD

## Specialised Safety Training Programs

- [Lithium Fire Safety Awareness Training | AustFirePro](https://austfirepro.com.au/lithium-fire-safety-awareness): Lithium-ion battery fire safety and emergency response training
- [Understanding Queensland's Emergency Code Black | AFP](https://austfirepro.com.au/code-black-training): Code Black emergency and occupational violence response training
- [Spill Kit Training - Effectively Deal with Chemical Spills](https://austfirepro.com.au/spill-kit-training): Chemical spill response and spill kit training for workplace safety
- [In House First Response Training Course | Aust Fire Protection](https://austfirepro.com.au/in-house-training): On-site first response and fire safety training at AFP facilities
